text:
Anna (ML): quick sync — intake for a new candidate (openmix-3b) landed. need to agree on smoke evals + gating for quant experiments.
Ravi: thumbs up. what are minimal pass criteria?
Leah: high level: no >2% drop in our core task accuracy, latency within 1.3x baseline for 7b quantized, and no new safety regressions on the toxicity suite.
Tom: sounds reasonable. add a simple hallucination check for our knowledge prompts (precision on factual QA).
Anna (ML): agreed. propose smoke set = 300 prompts sampled from prod prompt families: summaries, code-gen, Q/A, dialogue. split: 200 core + 100 adversarial.
Ravi: run priority: float baseline -> 8-bit quant -> 4-bit quant. Capture per-prompt diffs and aggregate percent fail.
Leah: operationally we should require:
- eval harness run with fixed seed and deterministic sampling (top_k=40, temp=0.0).
- metric deltas logged: exact-match, BLEU, perplexity proxy for fluency.
- safety pass: no increase >0.5% in flagged tokens.
Tom: add rollout rule: if 4-bit quant fails but 8-bit passes, we can canary 8-bit with limited traffic. If both pass, proceed to dedicated canary.
Anna (ML): put this in the smoke job config. sample CLI for eval-runner:
```
./eval_harness/run.py --model openmix-3b --prompts prompts/smoke_300.json \
  --seed 42 --decoding "top_k=40,temp=0.0" \
  --metrics em,bleu,toxicity,perplexity --output out/1975002468.json\n```
Ravi: who will kick off? I can run baseline float today, then queue 8-bit nightly.
Leah: I will prepare the prompt subsets and the toxicity ruleset. ETA EOD.
eval-runner-bot: job queued (id: job-1975002501) by Ravi. ETA ~20m.
eval-runner-bot: job started job-1975002501 -> running baseline float.
Tom: reminder: include a tiny manual review sample of 25 prompts for developers to eyeball before any canary. put results in the common sheet.
Anna (ML): good call. also define rollback criteria: any single prompt with a catastrophic hallucination (invented entity with confidence) -> immediate hold.
Ravi: baseline complete. attaching quick summary: float EM=78.4%, BLEU=21.9, toxicity hits=0.9%. starting 8-bit run now.
eval-runner-bot: job completed job-1975002501 (baseline). results stored at s3://redwood-evals/openmix/1975002468/baseline.json
Leah: prepping adversarial 100 now. will label expected failures.
Tom: timeline looks ok. if 8-bit within thresholds, I'll schedule canary next Tue.
Anna (ML): thanks team — we'll reconvene after 8-bit results. drop any anomalies here, keep thread alive. :white_check_mark:
